newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ATC rating, estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ATC rating, estimates cut.

text.p: -- Southwest Securites said it cut its rating of ATC Communications to a neutral from its prior rating of buy and cut profit estimates for 1997 and 1998 after the company posted lower-than-expected fiscal 1997 second quarter earnings.
-- Shares fell two to 8-1/2 in early trading on Friday.
-- ATC posted Q2 earnings of $0.04 a share compared with the consensus estimate of $0.10 a share, Southwest said.

-- ATC's management attributed the shortfall to new internal reporting systems, which temporarily cut into revenue and operating margin, and lower revenue growth as customers become more comfortable with ATC's new senior management, analyst Mark Blackburn said in a research report.

-- He said ATC still has good prospects, but cut fiscal 1997 estimates to $0.29 from $0.43 and fiscal 1998 estimates to $0.41 from $0.62. He cited "a lack of communications with the investment community and the time frame required to complete the management transition and to ensure complete functioning of new internal reporting systems," for his more conservative view of the company.
